institute.name: Helix Anthropis Institute
institute.tagline: Working together towards the advancement of humanity and the common good.

story: A few friends came together with a dream and want to make it a reality.
mission: The mission of the Helix Anthropis Institute is to promote and facilitate initiatives that contribute to the advancement of humanity and the common good without discrimination. The Institute shall support internationally recognized agendas only insofar as they remain compatible with its Constitutional Principles. In fulfilling its mission, the Institute shall encourage the voluntary coordination of individuals, organisations, institutions and communities in pursuit of shared priorities serving the common good.
vision: The Helix Anthropis Institute envisions a world where individuals, organisations, institutions, and communities work together across borders and disciplines to address humanity’s interconnected challenges. Through cooperation, knowledge, innovation, and collective action, we strive to build a more sustainable, resilient, and prosperous future for all.
